request.subject: ICON:TECH:DINOSAUR:SEAMANSHIP

layers.text: Remove the red crest and the spikes from the head: the head becomes a smooth carved figurehead painted deep blue with bold orange stripes and a cream jaw, like the prow of the Dinosaur canoes. Keep the big bone-white horn, the canoe, the thick black outline and the style, on a transparent background.
